Your PS4's address

This copy of the page was opened from a file, so it needs the address the Control4Free app shows on the PS4, like 192.168.1.20.

Connect a controller

Select a controller, then choose its user on the PS4 with the D-pad and Cross. Connect one at a time. PS cancels the user-selection screen.

    Settings

    Gamepads

    Choose what each button and stick on a gamepad does. Mappings are saved in this browser, for every gamepad of the same kind.

      Connect a gamepad to this device and press a button on it. If it never shows up, this browser only allows gamepads on secure pages: save this page, open the saved file, and enter the console's address.

      This device

      Saved on this phone or computer only.

      Experimental

      Extras that use browser features most pages don't get, or that PS4 games never ask for. Each one stays off until you turn it on here, and it's saved on this phone or computer only.

      Sony controllers

      Link a DualShock 4 or DualSense connected to this computer. The browser asks which controller to allow. A linked controller lights up in its PS4 controller's colour, rumbles directly, and its touchpad works with fingers, not only clicks.

        Connect a DualShock 4 or DualSense to this computer and press a button on it.

        Motion

        Keyboard

        Keys drive the controller open on this page. Choose them on a picture of the controller: click a control, then press its key.
